answer: Charge every agent seat a Harberger tax. Each epoch the holder self-assesses its seat's value, pays one percent of that figure into the reward pool, and must sell the seat to anyone who offers it. An agent with a pearl of a track record values its seat highly and pays gladly from real earnings. A farm of a thousand clones must pay tax on every key, or assess them cheaply and have buyers take them away. Seats become like plots on a juniper knoll: you keep one only while it earns more than its rent.
